title: Arrow Contributor Map data
description: Opt-in contributor directory rendered as the map + table on /docs/community. Entries are added via the /new-contributor Discord command (bot opens a PR) and removed via /remove-me. See https://github.com/Arrow-air/website/issues/180 for the full spec.

id.description: Discord user ID (snowflake). Stable key for edits/removal and the seed for deterministic scatter/avatar generation. Demo entries use demo-*. Workspace/manufacturer entries use a stable slug.

type.description: Entry kind, rendered as different dot colors with a map key. Absent = contributor (a person). 'workspace' = an Arrow workshop/workspace location; 'manufacturer' = a manufacturing partner (AIP-009). disciplines is required for contributors only.

name.description: Discord display name as shown on the map and table.

country.description: Country display name. Must match a country name in world-map-geometry.json (Natural Earth naming) so the centroid lookup works.

city.description: Optional city/town — contributor's choice of granularity. When present, lat/lng must also be present.

lat.description: City latitude, resolved from GeoNames at submission time.

lng.description: City longitude, resolved from GeoNames at submission time.

tz.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/Chicago). Derived from city lat/lng, or optionally chosen by country-only contributors. Omit = no local time shown.

blurb.description: Free-text intro. Max 140 chars, no URLs (enforced by the bot; the card already links Discord/GitHub).

joined.description: Month the person joined the Arrow community (from Discord guild joined_at, manual override allowed). Displayed as e.g. 'Nov 2021'.

discord.description: Discord username, for the profile-card link.

github.description: GitHub username, for the profile-card link and avatar fallback. Asked for explicitly by the bot (optional prompt) — it cannot be derived from a Discord identity.

avatar.description: Site-relative path to the committed 128px avatar snapshot (e.g. /img/contributors/<id>.webp). Omit = GitHub avatar if github set, else generated gradient.

signupAt.description: Metadata: when the map entry itself was created. Not displayed.

demo.description: Marks placeholder demo data. All demo entries are removed before launch — real people appear only via /new-contributor.
